_comment: adapters/deepseek/verify_dsh_run.py config for one DSH trial run of a work order (2.2.2-ds.3). Paths are relative to this file. Only project_dir, repo, order and code_files are required; the others show their defaults or an example.
_comment_defaults: order_id = the WO-<n> at the start of the order file name; report / log / verdict / summary / evidence_dir / director_config / run_base default to <DIRECTOR>/reports/<WO>_TASK_REPORT.md, DIRECTOR_LOG.md, reviews/<WO>_GATE_VERDICT.md, reports/RUN_SUMMARY.md (null = not required), evidence/, director_work.json, RUN_BASE.txt (BASE_COMMIT / PREPARED_AT / SESSIONS_BEFORE lines).
old_tests: <tests that existed before; they must not change and are rerun>

tests: <the Director's hidden acceptance tests, kept outside the project dir>

patterns: <regex of a hidden path; default: <oracle folder>/+<oracle file> per oracle test>
hidden.label: <how D08 names it>
